title: Fonts
description: Each array of fonts creates a priority-based order. The first font in the array should be the ideal font, followed by sensible, web-safe fallbacks

items.name: Display
items.description: Display font stack for headings and large text: an editorial serif available on every system (Iowan Old Style on Apple devices, Palatino Linotype on Windows, Georgia as a safety net). No download needed.

items.name: Base
items.description: Base font stack for body text. Atkinson Hyperlegible, named after the founder of the Braille Institute, has been developed specifically to increase legibility for readers with low vision, and to improve comprehension. It is self-hosted in /assets/fonts/atkinson.

items.name: Mono
items.description: Monospace font for code and preformatted text.
